attacker_pocs.name: short_ipv6_host
attacker_pocs.why: curl_url_set parses the bracketed host and passes its short IPv6 text to curlx_inet_pton; the new trailing-colon check reads before the allocated hostname buffer.

role_a_rationale: The patch rejects IPv6 addresses ending in a lone colon while retaining compressed valid forms, with focused unit checks. Its short-input lookbehind in the new check is a heap buffer overread reachable through curl_url_set on a bracketed host; the parent rejects the same host without an ASan finding. The change is confined to the IPv6 parser and its unit test.
